localizedValues.name: W1
localizedValues.description: This walk-in site is located close together with the other walk-in sites. The tent platform is 10 feet x 12 feet with tie-down points around the edges. A parking spot for one vehicle is available nearby. There is one shared communal fire pit and a communal outdoor cooking shelter with picnic tables. Propane fire pits and BBQs are only allowed on the communal gravel area. Small, portable propane cooking stoves are allowed to be used on the picnic tables. A bear cache with a locker and bike rack are available nearby. Bring a small padlock to secure food and personal items in the bear cache.
